message: 作為はだめ

name: Misa
message: 「Fwaaaah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's a yawn big enough to swallow a truck」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I didn't yawn! And don't take pictures of me, Azel-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... factoring... sines and cosines...」

name: Synn
message: 「Fwaaaah」

name: Ria
message: 「U-um... looks like everyone's working hard」

name: Sally
message: 「I came to play~」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa. What's with all these dead bodies everywhere!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone is having a rough time because of exams」

name: Sally
message: 「Exams? Is that something you can eat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Must be nice, ghosts don't have exams or school」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm not a ghost」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey. Synn-sama. If you don't hurry up, class is gonna start」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... fwaah... right...」

name: Ria
message: 「Any announcements?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, yes. Starting today until the end of exams, there won't be any after-school Student Council meetings. We'll still gather like this in the mornings... just to pass along announcements. We'll keep doing patrols, though. That's all」

name: Synn
message: 「Fwaaah」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun, you're slacking off! You're the Student Council President, you know」

name: Misa
message: 「I gotta pull myhelf together... fwaah」

name: Misa
message: 「I told you, stop taking pictures!」

name: Azel
message: 「Got a shot all the way inside」

name: Misa
message: 「W-what do you mean 'all the way inside'!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka, what are you doing? Spreading out the accounting ledger all of a sudden?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You perk up too, Synn! We're having him take pictures of us looking like we're doing proper Student Council work. Looking like a bunch of yawners would be a disgrace!」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, yes. Even without that, I always take my duties seriously, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And so, take a picture right now, right now! Capture my gallant figure hard at work on treasurer duties!」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Why?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is because Ms. Treasurer is disliked.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did I even do anything?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Therefore, please take a picture of me instead. Smiles are zero yen.」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why me too? You don't need to hold back, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aren't you just disliked too?」

name: Sally
message: 「Vee. Peace, peace.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And on top of that, you're only photographing Ms. Extra?!」

name: Azel
message: 「She's natural. You people aren't natural. Do your Student Council work naturally. I don't feel like shooting posed setups.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-He sounds kinda legit.」

name: Misa
message: 「Whoa...」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, how is everyone's studying for the exams going?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When the new party is annihilated, even fire feels cool. This means a political party named 'Annihilation' from the very start is already finished. In other words, I have given up.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is the worst I've ever seen.」

name: Misa
message: 「Things are way worse on my end!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ms. Vice President really competes no matter the situation, doesn't she?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's it! We just have to give up on them as if they never existed in the first place!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka, take this a little more seriously.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, I originally got in through a special talent exam anyway.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I remember right, it was soba noodle making, wasn't it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Our academy really pulls some radical stunts sometimes...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah... You sure are calm about this, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「It's no matter of life and death」

name: Ria
message: 「That's a little\s02」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see, those are very enlightening words」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What a wonderful mindset! Let me call you Master!」

name: Misa
message: 「Everyone, pull yourselves together!」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey! I'm staying calm too! Call me master」

name: Lolotte
message: 「An extra like you who doesn't even have a test to begin with doesn't count」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. What about your Leica?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's a matter of life and death」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talk about a quick change of tune」
